releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.0.0 — Grand Unified Architecture:
- Shader Cache Policy & Preservation Engine: Added 'PRESERVE SHADERS' toggle to protect DX12 PSO, NVIDIA DXCache, AMD, and Unreal Engine shader pipelines during system sweeps, eliminating game pre-loading stutters.
- Battery Health & Degradation Forensics Engine: Background 60s watt-hour depletion tracking, app energy efficiency scorecard (mW drained per active app), and one-click exportable battery forensics report.
- Autonomous Zero-Lag Display Resync: Hooks WM_DISPLAYCHANGE (0x007E) to flush DWM frame latency and auto-lock 144Hz native refresh rate upon monitor connect/disconnect.
- Universal Laptop Hardware Abstraction (HAL v2): Multi-vendor BIOS & WMI thermal bridge for HP, ASUS, Lenovo, Acer, Dell, and generic ACPI.
- Restored VoltMaster CPU Controls & AeroFrame Low-Latency Governor.
